"When Shane was still in primary school (when I first imagined Shane all those years ago), he had a teacher who fancied him quite a bit. She even taught him a couple of things.
However, when Shane grew up and got cubs of his own, he hung around the same area. He never really moved out. Therefor his cubs went to the same school, where he met up with miss Pascalle again during parent/teacher conferences.
During these nights Pascalle always had a "sudden issue" with one of Shane's cubs that needed him to stay privately afterwards. At least, that was the story the other parents knew. What really happened in there was quite different." - Commissioner
